mapper.select: select bed.number as bed_number,bed.type as bed_type,room.number,room.type,room.gender,room.bed_count from bed join room on bed.room_id = room.id where bed.is_null=0

select bed.number as bed_number , bed.type as bed_type , patient_information.name , patient_information.gender , patient_information.age , room.number , room.type , room.gender as room_gender , room.bed_count from bed join room on bed.room_id = room.id join patient_information on bed.patient_id = patient_information.id where bed.is_null = 1;
mapper.update: update bed as b1 join bed as b2 on b1.id = (select bed_id from patient_information where id = #{patientId1}) and b2.id = (select bed_id from patient_information where id = #{patientId2}) set b1.patient_id = b2.patient_id, b2.patient_id = b1.patient_id;
update patient_information as p1 join patient_information as p2 on p1.id= #{patientId1} and p2.id = #{patientId2} set p1.bed_id = p2.bed_id , p2.bed_id = p1.bed_id;
